Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Y. V. Giri, Sr. Advocate  Mr.Pranav Kumar, Advocate  For the Opposite Party/s : Ms.Gulnar Begum, APP

======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PURNENDU SINGH  ORAL ORDER 2 19-10-2023 As prayed for, learned counsel for the petitioner is permitted to implead Regional Director, the Reserve Bank of India, Patna, Bihar as opposite party no.2 in course of the day.

entities.text: Reserve Bank of India, Patna, Bihar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
2. Let the name of counsel, who appears on behalf of the Reserve Bank of India, be reflected in the Cause List henceforth.
3.
Heard Mr. Y. V. Giri, learned senior counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner and Ms. Gulnar Begum, learned APP for the State.
4. The petitioner seeks pre-arrest bail in connection with Ishipur Barahat P.S. Case No. 100 of 2023 dated 27.07.2023 registered for the offence(s) punishable under Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No.
67533 of 2023(2) dt.19-10-2023 Sections 420, 409/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

5. Call for the audit report for the financial years 2021-22 and 2022-23, relating to the period of the petitioner while he was posted as the capacity of Branch Manager at Dakshin Bihar Gramin Bank,
Ishipur Barahat Branch to verify, as to whether, the allegation based on the inquiry report, which Satyam Sinha vs The State Of Bihar on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/157714914/
1 has been reported by the inspecting team of the Bank on the direction of the Chief Manager, Audit and Inspection of Dakshin Bihar Gramin Bank, Patna, according to learned senior counsel, is with vested enmity between the present Branch Manager as well as the petitioner, against whom, just after few days of his transfer on 28.02.2023, the FIR has been lodged on 24.07.2023.
6.

entities.text:
Dakshin Bihar Gramin Bank,
Ishipur Barahat Branch
entities.label: ORG

entities.text: Satyam Sinha vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is submitted that prima facie no illegality or any misappropriation of public money has been committed by the petitioner.

The inquiry report reveals that five persons are responsible for alleged large scale misappropriation of public money, however, petitioner has solely been held responsible for the same and has been suspended for the said allegation by instituting an FIR only against the petitioner.
7. It is reported in many cases that the officers including the Board of Directors of the Bank are involved in misappropriating the public fund or the funds, which are Patna High Court CR. MISC.
No. 67533 of 2023(2) dt.19-10-2023 required for the government schemes and are distributed to the Bank.

8. The Regional Director, Reserve Bank of India, Patna, Bihar is directed to constitute a team of officers to enquire into the functioning of the concerned South Bihar Gramin Bank and submit a report with respect to the alleged financial misappropriation which has been reported by the inspecting team of the Bank on the direction of the Chief Manager, Audit and Inspection of Dakshin Bihar Gramin Bank, Patna.
9. The Superintendent of Police concerned is directed to also submit independent report on the basis of the audit report with respect to the financial years, as mentioned above.
10. The respective authorities must submit their respective reports within a period of eight weeks from the date of passing of this order.

11. Call for the up-to-date legible carbon/photostat copy of the case diary in connection with /Ishipur Barahat P.S. Case No. 100 of 2023 from the Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Bhagalpur / successor court.
12.

entities.text:
Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Bhagalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
In the meantime, the petitioner, above-named, who has been singled out by the informant on the basis of the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No. 67533 of 2023(2) dt.19-10-2023 direction of the Chief Manager, Audit and Inspection, is directed to be released on provisional bail, in the event of his surrender before the Court below within a period of four weeks from today, on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bhagalpur in connection with Ishipur Barahat P.S. Case No.
100 of 2023, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C.
13.
